integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and accompanying finite checker; experiments do not replace proof. No assertion of independent or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only moduli 2^k and indices 0 <= n < 2^k; no general assertion for arbitrary composite moduli or sums of polygonal numbers. The 2-adic square-root formulas are classical and not claimed as original. The priority comparison is bounded and an unindexed equivalent could exist.
title: Exact dyadic fiber spectra of polygonal numbers
